_doc: Bottle geometry for the DR collection (sim/bottle_mesh.py), kept OUT of sim/dr_config.json so a cup run never replays cup trajectories with a bottle: scripts/dr_collect.py --objects sim/dr_objects_bottle.json replaces objects.geometry (and physics_replay.expected_config when given) in the work dir's copy of the config. 2026-11-11, Boyu + Claude.
_status: MEASURED IN PART (2026-11-11). The real bottle is 御茶園 特撰冰釀綠茶 590ml [Boyu]; the shop pages (momo, PChome, uni-prosperity) list only the volume, and a 550 ml variant of the same line exists, do not mix. Sizes are Boyu's measurements (see bottle_ref._source); mass and friction are still 未確認; 3 ring grooves modelled (12.4 / 14.3 / 16.0 cm, 0.8 cm wide, 0.2 cm deep).
_not_done: physics_replay's config check (dr_collect 'check' step) runs the default paper-cup asset, not these objects, so it says nothing about the bottle; a bottle expected_config needs one run on the 4090 first. dr_render.py look: since 2026-11-13 a bottle gets its own (clear / tinted PET, opaque cap, optional label sleeve; dr_config.json objects.bottle_appearance), not yet rendered on the 4090 (test list: docs/specs/S9_sim_dr_collect.md section 5); object USDs made before 2026-11-13 have no Cap mesh, rerun the objects step. Standing bottles only: the 11 tipped demos (object_orientation lying) need an orientation input physics_replay does not have.

geometry._source: Boyu measured 2026-11-11 (ruler / tape, 'about'): height 23 cm with cap; body circumference 21.8 cm -> dia 6.939 (circumference / pi); waist circumference 18.4 cm -> dia 5.857, narrowest at 7.3 cm height; base dia 6.3; shoulder starts 18.2, neck starts 20.7; neck dia 3.0, cap dia 2.8, cap from 21.5 -> cap_h 1.5 (confirmed). Empty, cap on; no scale. Body has spiral grooves (not modelled: smooth solid). body_points: foot 6.3 -> waist 5.857 at 7.3 -> full 6.939 from 11.8 cm (Boyu measured). Still 未確認: shell_mass + cap_mass (not weighed, 18 + 2 g), mu_s / mu_d. 2026-11-11 update: body dia 7.0 cm = caliper-style measurement at the widest point of the grooved section (Boyu); tape circumference at 14 cm is 21.5 cm (-> 6.84 if round), lower than the widest point because the 3 grooves there take part of the tape. The photo outline (scratchpad, 11/11) gave 6.2 cm there: its edge detection picked the inside of the white label, not used. Grooves still not modelled. Grooves (Boyu 2026-11-11): 3 rings centred at 12.4 / 14.3 / 16.0 cm, about 0.8 cm wide and 0.2 cm deep. Lower section (Boyu 2026-11-11, outline 'flat - in - out - flat' from the bottom up): straight at about 6.9 cm up to 3.3 cm, then in to the waist. Foot: 6.3 at z = 0 (the earlier base measurement) rounding out to 6.9 by 1.2 cm (from the photo outline: 6.35 at 1.0 cm, 6.7 at 1.5 cm; 推論).
